_doc: Sound effects generated with the ElevenLabs sound-generation API (see generate.py). name: the game's sound id (src/audio.js synth names); n: variants; dur: requested seconds.
style: Clean, punchy, close-miked video game sound effect, no music, no voices, no background noise, single isolated sound.

sounds.name: whoosh
sounds.prompt: Fast sword swing whoosh through the air, sharp swish

sounds.name: throw
sounds.prompt: Spinning spear thrown through the air, fluttering whoosh

sounds.name: flyby
sounds.prompt: Arrow whizzing past close to the ear, quick zip

sounds.name: thud
sounds.prompt: Cartoon punch hitting a padded body, punchy smack

sounds.name: crunch
sounds.prompt: Heavy club hit to a body with a comic bony crunch

sounds.name: thump
sounds.prompt: Body falling and landing on grassy ground, soft heavy thump with a little dirt

sounds.name: slash
sounds.prompt: Sword blade slicing through cloth and a body, quick slash with a wet chop

sounds.name: stab
sounds.prompt: Spear point stabbing into a body, short thwick thunk

sounds.name: clang
sounds.prompt: Steel sword striking plate armour, bright metallic clang with a short ring

sounds.name: block
sounds.prompt: Sword hitting a wooden shield, hollow wooden thock with a rattle

sounds.name: shield
sounds.prompt: Weapon hitting a metal-rimmed wooden shield, knock with a metal ring

sounds.name: bow
sounds.prompt: Bow string twang releasing an arrow, taut twang and thwip

sounds.name: fire
sounds.prompt: Fireball launched, roaring whoosh of flame with crackles

sounds.name: boom
sounds.prompt: Cartoonish big explosion, deep boom with debris, punchy and not too long

sounds.name: debris
sounds.prompt: Rubble, dirt and small rocks raining down on the ground after an explosion

sounds.name: pop
sounds.prompt: Glass potion bottle shattering with a bubbly pop and fizz

sounds.name: heal
sounds.prompt: Magical healing spell, soft shimmering chime sparkle rising

sounds.name: gong
sounds.prompt: Big bronze gong struck once, deep shimmering ring

sounds.name: horn
sounds.prompt: Medieval war horn blast, one long deep heroic call

sounds.name: click
sounds.prompt: Soft wooden UI click, short and pleasant, menu selection

sounds.name: place
sounds.prompt: Small toy soldier placed on a wooden table, soft cheerful plop

sounds.name: remove
sounds.prompt: Small toy soldier lifted off a table, soft quick reverse pop

sounds.name: lute
sounds.prompt: Single cheerful strum of a medieval lute
